notes: Maps Colorado DFPC certification titles and notable local rules onto stable national catalog IDs. Only differences and Colorado-specific conditions are recorded here.

certifications.affiliationDetail: Must be affiliated with a Colorado Emergency Services Agency for initial certification pathway.
certifications.hazmatNotes: Colorado minimally requires Hazardous Materials Operations (not Awareness alone) in the Fire Fighter I certification path.

testing.practical: Mandatory and randomly selected JPRs; 100% practical pass standard
testing.liveBurnNotes: Live Burn Practical Examination required for Fire Fighter I.

certifications.notes: Complete written, practical, and live-burn components per DFPC process. HazMat Ops may be sequenced with FF I components under current policy timing rules.
